title: Lietavská Lúčka
sampleSentence: Lietavská Lúčka (Hungarian: Litvailló) is a village and municipality in Žilina District in the Žilina Region of northern Slovakia..
fullTextRaw:
Lietavská Lúčka (Hungarian: Litvailló) is a village and municipality in Žilina District in the Žilina Region of northern Slovakia.

In historical records the village was first mentioned in 1393.

The municipality lies at an altitude of 363 metres (1,191 ft) and covers an area of 6.49 km2 (2.51 sq mi) (2025). It has a large gender imbalance with women outnumbering men almost 2 to 1.

It has a population of 1869 people (31 December 2025).

In year 2021 was  1878 people by ethnicity  1806 as Slovak,  73 as Not found out,  9 as Czech,  4 as Jewish,  4 as Romani,  4 as Other,  3 as Russian,  3 as Polish,  3 as German,  3 as Greek,  2 as Serbian,  1 as Vietnamese,  1 as Ukrainian,  1 as Hungarian and  1 as Canadian.

Note on population: The difference values of population numbers in the table "Population statistic" and in the sections "Ethnicity" & "Religion" is caused by the use of various statistical methods.

In year 2021 was 1878 people by religion  1278 from Roman Catholic Church,  460 from None,  66 from Not found out,  28 from Evangelical Church,  8 from Ad hoc movements,  6 from Calvinist Church,  6 from Christian Congregations in Slovakia,  6 from Other,  4 from Old Catholic Church,  4 from Greek Catholic Church,  4 from Buddhism,  2 from Eastern Orthodox Church,  1 from Jewish community,  1 from Paganism and natural spirituality,  1 from Islam,  1 from United Methodist Church,  1 from Seventh-day Adventist Church and  1 from Apostolic Church.
